claimWinnings().details: Claims the winning payout for the caller. Calculates proportional share of the winning pool minus the protocol fee.

closeMarket().details: Closes the market for new bets. Callable by anyone once the deadline is reached.

constructor.details: Initializes the market and seeds initial liquidity. Initial liquidity is split 50/50 between YES and NO from msg.value.

params._deadline: The deadline after which bets can no longer be placed (unix timestamp).
params._oracle: The address of the PythiaOracle contract authorized to resolve this market.
params._strikePrice: The strike price for price-based markets.
params._treasury: The address of the protocol treasury to receive fees.

placeBet(bool).details: Places a bet on the market.

params.side: True to bet YES, false to bet NO.

resolve(bool).details: Resolves the market with the final outcome. Only callable by the oracle.

params._outcome: True if YES won, false if NO won.

withdrawFees().details: Withdraws accumulated protocol fees. Only callable by the treasury.
